cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded fuel card with Indian Oil, offering accelerated rewards on fuel purchases, surcharge waivers, and additional benefits on groceries and utilities.

benefitRows.name: IndianOil
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, ensure your IndianOil credit card is active. Spend ₹50,000 in the first year to earn a waiver on the renewal membership fee. Use your card at IndianOil outlets to accumulate Fuel Points, which can be redeemed for free fuel and other rewards through the IndianOil XTRAREWARDS program.
